<a id="c-pure-espresso"></a>
# PureEspresso

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

An espresso drink with nothing but coffee and water.

- Abstract: it has no members of its own, only its subclasses do.
- Is a: [EspressoDrink](c-espresso-drink.md)
- Subclasses: [Americano](c-americano.md), [Espresso](c-espresso.md), [LongBlack](c-long-black.md), [Lungo](c-lungo.md), [Ristretto](c-ristretto.md)
- Disjoint with: [MilkDrink](c-milk-drink.md), [SweetenedDrink](c-sweetened-drink.md)

- **contains:** What goes into the drink.
- **origin:** Where the drink was first made.
- **pourOrder:** What goes in the cup first, and what goes on top.
- **pullVolumeMl:** Milliliters of espresso pulled for one drink.
- **variationOf:** A drink this one is a twist on.

## Decisions

<a id="d-8wg5vc"></a>
### Menu names for pure espressos

**Decision.** The pure espresso drinks keep their menu names.

**Why.** Nobody orders a LongBlackEspresso.

**Explains the rules:** `naming-subclass-names-consistent`
